recipes.name: 18 Pound Giant Fried Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 6 pounds boneless, skin on chicken thighs, cut in half
3 Chinese chives, cut into inch pieces
instructions: For the Prep

Begin by microplaning garlic and peeled ginger for the marinade. Transfer to a mixing bowl, then add soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, and msg. Whisk to combine. - 12 garlic cloves microplaned - 2 inches ginger peeled and microplaned - ½ cup soy sauce - ½ cup sake - ¼ cup mirin - ½ cup sugar - 2 tbsp msg
Prepare the boneless chicken thighs by halving into large chunks. - 6 pounds boneless skin on chicken thighs, cut in half
Add the chicken to the mixing bowl and gently toss to coat in the marinade. Transfer to the fridge and allow to marinate for 30 minutes to 1 hour. - boneless skin on chicken thighs, cut in half
For the Rice

Wash rice until the water runs clear, then transfer to the rice cooker with a water level that reaches about one length of your pinky above the surface of the rice. Cook according to instructions. - 4 cups medium grain white rice
While the chicken is marinating and the rice is cooking, you can prepare your toppings.
For the Karaage

When the chicken is finished marinating, remove from the fridge and toss with potato starch using tongs and your hands making sure the potato starch is evenly distributed. - 3 cups potato starch - 6 pounds boneless skin on chicken thighs, cut in half
Before frying the chicken, prep the Stir Fry ingredients and Toppings.
For the Stir Fry
Cut the Chinese chives into thick pieces and thinly slice the pork shoulder. - 3 Chinese chives cut into inch pieces - 1 ½ lbs thinly sliced pork shoulder
Bring a small pot of water to a boil and soft boil eggs for about 6 minutes and 45 seconds. Immediately plunge into an ice bath using a slotted spoon after time has elapsed. - 4 soft boiled eggs
In the same pot of boiling water, blanche bean sprouts for about 1 minute. Drain using a fine mesh sieve. - bean sprouts
Roughly chop yellow onions - 3 yellow onions thickly sliced
Set aside all Stir Fry ingredients and Toppings for later use. - For the Stir Fry - For the Toppings
For the Fried Chicken
Preheat a large Dutch Oven with 2-4 inches of oil to 350°F - 375°F - vegetable oil for frying
Line a few baking sheets with paper towels and wire racks.

Transfer a few pieces of chicken to the oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pot, and cook until lightly golden brown, 3-5 minutes. - For the Karaage - 6 pounds boneless skin on chicken thighs, cut in half
Then transfer to the paper towel lined sheet tray. Repeat with the rest of the chicken.
Let the chicken rest while you work on the Stir Fry.
For the Stir Fry
In a large, deep skillet or wok over high heat, add oil and pork shoulder and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the pork is lightly browned. - thinly sliced pork shoulder - 2 tbsp vegetable oil

Next add the yellow onions and soy sauce. Toss gently and continue to cook until the onions are softened and browned around the edges. Season with salt, msg and sugar and continue to toss to combine. Taste and adjust for seasoning. - yellow onions thickly sliced - ¼ cup soy sauce - ½ msg - 1 tbsp sugar
Remove from the heat and add Chinese chives. Toss again to combine and set aside. - Chinese chives cut into inch pieces
For the Toppings
Thinly slice white cabbage. - ¼ white cabbage thinly sliced
For the Serving

Pile the rice to the bottom of a large serving platter, then top it with bean sprouts, the pork stir fry, then the fried chicken, sliced cabbage, sliced soft boiled eggs and lemon. - medium grain white rice - bean sprouts - thinly sliced pork shoulder - boneless skin on chicken thighs, cut in half - white cabbage thinly sliced - soft boiled eggs - ½ lemon
Serve hot and share with friends!
